title: Effect of Sintering Temperature on the Microstructure and Integrated Properties of MgAlTiVFeCo Lightweight High-Entropy Alloy

recollection.structure: guess: refined microstructure with varying grain sizes
recollection.mechanism: guess: diffusion and precipitation of alloying elements

score.note: The recollection identifies temperature-varied sintering but does not specify SPS or the optimal 1000 °C condition. Its grain-refinement claim misses the dense microstructure and uniformly distributed oxide barrier phases. Diffusion and precipitation are broadly relevant, but the passive-film corrosion mechanism and parabolic, diffusion-controlled oxidation are absent. No quantitative values are recalled.
